doc.title: diamond_proam_9ft — pocket-assembly declaration (V18) for the gully export (GULLY g1)
doc.notes: MESH NAMES ARE THE SCENE NAMES: the D621 render sets render.dmNames = true, and table.js's dm() helper stores every Diamond mesh as `dm-<name>` (dmFor, GULLY-FIX1 correction — the g1 declaration listed bare names and would have matched nothing). Per pocket tag pt = c0 s1 c2 c3 s4 c5 (kernel order): dm-pocketcup-/dm-pocketcupfloor- (the trap cup the ball falls through), dm-bootskirt-/dm-boothem-/dm-bootbowl-/dm-bootcollar-/dm-bootrim-/dm-bootstitch-/dm-falllip- (the boot the sink pose descends); returnshaft-/returnfloor- (the pre-D621 sealed void, built only by the old boot path) in both spellings so main's served model is covered too. The cabinet shell is NOT declared: winding number 0 in the hollow interior (ballreturn's probe), and the six entry crossings are now real OPENINGS cut in the side panels (GULLY-FIX1 C1) with a dark sleeve (own hardware) — the surface rule is measured by tools/render/d621/plan/gully_route_arm_621.mjs against the built meshes. The 12 BARE rows (returnshaft-<pt> / returnfloor-<pt>) match main's pre-D621 boot only; on the D621 tables this file lands on they are INERT (no such mesh is built) and are kept so the same declaration reads correctly on main's model (ballreturn B1-1 item a).
